exclusions: Exclusions the paper and codebook state, applied per effect (a participant dropped from one effect stays in the others): Kay - any of kay*.4-6 missing; Rottenstreich, Bauer, Hsee, Knobe, Risen, Tversky, Shafir, Schwarz - needs the outcome item(s) of the condition seen; Critcher - estimate must lie in 0-100; Ross 1 and 2 - all three items answered and the percentage estimate(s) in 0-100; Hauser trolley 1 - under 4 s on the target scenario page excluded (the paper's aggregate N = 6,842 keeps participants with prior experience; the no-prior-experience restriction applies only to the comparison with the original and is not applied); Zaval - zav.include.strict (excludes unscrambling errors). No global exclusion on the attention checks (IMC1/IMC2) is stated for the primary analyses, so none is applied. Paper-only restrictions (university samples for Savani, English sites for Zaval's direct test, sample-size cuts per lab) are not applied.

Hauser: side-effect vs greater-good permissibility (d from odds ratio)
Tversky & Kahneman: framing, cheap vs costly item on sale (d from odds ratio)

Hsee: less is better, scarf minus coat generosity (d)
Schwarz: assimilation/contrast, specific-first minus general-first correlation (Cohen's q)

Zaval: heat minus cold priming, concern about global warming (d)
